en: Do you dare to marry me?
If you're not scared, / then what do I have to be worried about?

cn: 不是吧，/ 我真的有老婆了？// 命运戒指牛逼！
en: No way, / I actually have a wife now? // This fate ring rocks!

cn: 回家收拾一下找个工作吧！
en: Okay, / go home, freshen up, / and find a job!

cn: 毕竟我现在有老婆要养了！
en: After all, / I have a wife to support now.
Why is it so hard to find a job?

cn: 太好了！/ 老子的人生终于要开始转运了！
en: Awesome! // My luck is finally starting to turn around!

cn: 明明是个软件工程的高材生，
en: He's obviously a top software engineering graduate, /
so how come he doesn't have a job?

cn: 这份资料应该能给你答案。
en: This file should give you the answer.

cn: Damián有个女友在我们公司上班，
en: Damián has a girlfriend working at our company, /

cn: 直接安排Damián成为她的顶头上司，

en: Based on his résumé, / he's more than qualified.
